table.retrieve:
SELECT   
	serviceOheader.serviceOcode , 
	serviceOheader.date , 
	serviceOheader.remarks , 
	aliasname = accounts.aliasname,
	serviceOheader.custcode , 
	serviceOheader.salesmancode ,
	serviceOheader.headerno,  
	users.username , 
	serviceOheader.discperc , 
	serviceOheader.flatdisc , 
	serviceOheader.misccharges , 
	serviceOheader.posted , 
	serviceOheader.postdate , 
	customerbalance = 0,
	debitorcredit = ' ',
	patientRegNo=(SELECT Patient.Regno FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = serviceOheader.patientcode),
	serviceOheader.originaldate,
	serviceOheader.modifiedby,
	serviceOheader.postedby,
	serviceOheader.cashreceived,
	serviceOheader.doctcode,
	serviceOheader.patientcode,

	FullPatientName=serviceOheader.FullPatientName,
	PatientAge=serviceOheader.PatientAge,
	PatientSex=serviceOheader.PatientSex,
	PatientRefBy=serviceOheader.PatientRefBy,
	ServiceInvTypeCode=serviceOheader.ServiceInvTypeCode,
	MessageCode=serviceOheader.MessageCode,
	ServiceInvGSTPerc=serviceOheader.ServiceInvGSTPerc,

	serviceOheader.Reference1,
	serviceOheader.Reference2,
	serviceOheader.Reference3,
	serviceOheader.Reference4,
	serviceOheader.Reference5,
	ServiceOrderStatusCode=serviceOheader.ServiceOrderStatusCode,
	OperationDate=serviceOheader.OperationDate,
	DischargeDate=serviceOheader.DischargeDate,
	NextOfKins=serviceOheader.NextOfKins,
	NextOfKinsRelationCode=serviceOheader.NextOfKinsRelationCode,
	NextOfKinsCNIC=serviceOheader.NextOfKinsCNIC,
	NextOfKinsPhone=serviceOheader.NextOfKinsPhone,
	NextOfKinsAddress=serviceOheader.NextOfKinsAddress
FROM  
	customer , 
	serviceOheader, 
	users , 
	accounts  
WHERE 
	serviceOheader.custcode = customer.custcode and 
	users.usercode = serviceOheader.salesmancode and 
	serviceOheader.custcode = accounts.acccode and 
	dbo.serviceOheader.serviceOcode = :ar_SaleInvCode
